title: Jiu-Jitsu Karate

services.name: MMA for Teens
services.desc: For over 30-years, North Texas MMA offers adult Jiu-Jitsu, No-Gi, Muay Thai kickboxing, and MMA training in Flower Mound. Whether you are brand new, getting back into shape, or looking for serious martial arts training, our adult classes give you a practical way to build skill and fitness. Adults train for different reasons. Some want self-defense. Some want a workout that does not feel like a treadmill. Some want to learn Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, improve striking, or train with a consistent group of people who take the work seriously. Our schedule gives adults room to train often and build at their own pace. You do not need to be in shape before starting. Training is how you get in shape.
